title: The DVR purity step for a punctured finite etale cover
statement: Let A be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. Let q:L→Spec A [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] be smooth with geometrically connected fibres [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let V be the open complement of the closed point. Let n:N→L be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and etale on q⁻¹V [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose W is an open of L containing a point x of the special fibre and n is etale on W. Then there are a finite etale morphism p:E→L and an isomorphism N|q⁻¹V ≅ E|q⁻¹V commuting with the maps to q⁻¹V. Neither normality of E nor density of its puncture is part of this statement. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption on q is required.

source.place: Tag 0EYE (Lemma 58.31.3); Tag 0EYJ (Lemma 58.31.8), first two paragraphs of the proof

proof.text: Use the actual scheme-theoretic special fibre D=q.fiber s and inclusion i=q.fiberι s. Smoothness gives flatness, and lem-sbc-flat-dvr-special-fiber-cartier proves i effective Cartier. Local finite type over the Noetherian DVR makes L locally Noetherian. The fibre morphism to the residue field is smooth, so D is locally Noetherian and regular by IsRegular.of_smooth.

GeometricallyConnected gives ConnectedSpace of the special fibre. IsRegular.isIntegral makes it integral. range_fiberι and hV identify q⁻¹V with the complement of i. The point x lifts to a point y of D by range_fiberι and hqx. The generic point specializes to y; map this specialization along i and use mem_open W.isOpen to prove i(genericPoint D) belongs to W.

Apply exists_finite_etale_extension_of_regular_integral_divisor to D, i, q⁻¹V, n, and W with the Cartier, regularity, integrality, complement, and generic-point membership facts just proved. This gives exactly the required finite etale extension and over-open restriction isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYJ, first two paragraphs; Tag 0EYE, via the regular-integral-divisor purity theorem. The Cartier pullback and generic-point assembly are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_etale_extension_of_dvr_neighbourhood
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    {L N : Scheme.{u}} (q : L ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [Smooth q] [GeometricallyConnected q]
    (V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ t : Spec (.of A), t ∈ V ↔ t ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (n : N ⟶ L) [IsFinite n]
    (het : Etale (n ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
    (W : L.Opens) (x : L) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (hqx : q x = IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) (hW : Etale (n ∣_ W)) :
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ L), IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧
      ∃ e : (n ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme ≅ (p ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ (p ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)) = n ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)
